text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Deep in Brisa Canyon, a young girl faces down a pack of monsters.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ブリザ渓谷にて、
一人の子供が魔物の群れと向き合っていた。

text_block_list.text:
Hahahahah!
You beasts have some nerve defying [i]me![/i]
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハーッハッハッハッ！
わらわに逆らうとは、
よい度胸をしておるな。

text_block_list.text: Allow me to show you a small taste of my power.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わらわの力を、
貴様らに見せてやろう。

text_block_list.text:
Beg and plead as you will, it is too late now!
Your fate is sealed!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今更泣き叫んでも、
もう遅いぞ。
覚悟するがいい！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GGRUOOOOGGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.text: Hm?! It had no effect whatsoever?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
むっ！？
効いておらぬじゃとっ！？

text_block_list.text:
Urghh... Alas...
To think my powers have faded to such an extent...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ぐう……
無念……
よもやここまでわらわの力が弱まっていようとは……

text_block_list.text:
You are... who, exactly?
No, it matters not.
It is dangerous for you to be here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お主は……何者じゃ。
いや、
それはよい。
ともかくここにいては危険じゃぞ……

text_block_list.text: Ahh... Where are you trying to carry me off to?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
わらわを背負ってどうするつもりじゃ！？

text_block_list.text:
You mean to help me flee this danger?
I... I see. Expending your efforts in my service...
text_block_list.orig_text:
わらわを連れて逃げるじゃと……？
そ、
そうか、
わらわのために働くと申すか……

text_block_list.text:
So be it!
I entrust my fate into your hands for now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……よかろう。
わらわの命運、
お主に託そうではないか。

text_block_list.text: It would appear the danger is now past.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……どうやら、
逃げ切れたようじゃな。

text_block_list.text:
Your swift actions proved to be my salvation.
Young man, what is your name?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ともかく、
お主のおかげで事なきを得た。
お主、
名はなんという？

text_block_list.text:
I see... {0}, is it?
You have done well.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほう、
{0}か。
よくやった。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
I am she who rules over the night, Illya Ornstein!
In recognition of your deeds, I shall make you my personal minion!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わらわこそ夜を統べる者、
イリヤ・オーンスタイン！
こたびの働きを評価し、
お主を我が眷属としてやろう！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Very good. A fine response!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うむうむ。
よい反応じゃ。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Excuse me?!
text_block_list.orig_text: なんじゃと！？

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
In the old days, an offer of minionship was enough
to make even the proudest of nobles weep tears of joy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
昔はわらわが眷属にしてやるといえば、
どんな相手でも泣いて喜んだものじゃというのに……！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, I have made my decision!
It is not your place to refuse!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ともかく、
これは決定事項じゃ！
お主に断る権利はない！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
You are officially a minion of mine now!
It is your duty to aid me from this day forth!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これで、お主はわらわの眷属じゃ！
今後とも、
わらわの助けになるがよい！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Still... a new minion is a fine thing,
but the problem at hand remains unsolved.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……しかし、
眷属を得たはいいが、
問題は何も解決しておらぬな……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: How could I allow my magical energies to sink so far?
text_block_list.orig_text: よもや、ここまで魔力が落ちておるとは……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
With the powers I possessed of old, I could have
turned such monsters to dust with a flick of my finger...
text_block_list.orig_text:
昔のわらわの魔力ならば、
魔物など指先一つで塵にできたというのに……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Hmm? Wh-why are you patting my head, of all things?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
むっ、
な、
なんじゃいきなり頭をなでおって！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Cheer up, you say?
D-do not treat me like a child!
text_block_list.orig_text:
元気を出せ、じゃと？
こ、
子供扱いするでない！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
To lay hands upon my noble head
is an honor I have bestowed upon no other!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わらわの頭をなでるなど、
誰にも許したことはないのじゃぞ……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what's this?!
I have returned to my true form?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
これは……！？
元の姿に戻っておる！？

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
How can this be?
All my attempts to restore my old body ended in failure...
text_block_list.orig_text:
どういうことじゃ……？
何をしても元の姿には戻れなかったというのに？？

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
S-still! Though the reason is unclear,
if my true form is restored to me, I have naught left to fear!
From now on—
text_block_list.orig_text:
し、
しかし、
理由はわからぬが、
元の姿に戻れたのならば、
もう怖いものはない！
これならば――

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Aaghh! I am a child once more?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああっ！？
また子供の姿にっ！？

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Nghh... What can this mean?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……むぅ……
どういうことじゃ。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
First you pat me upon the head,
then I suddenly regain my queenly stature...
text_block_list.orig_text:
お主に頭をなでられたと思ったら、
急にわらわが元の姿に戻った……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Could it be... you triggered this change somehow?
If that's the case... Hmm?
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしや……
お主が関係しておるのか……？
だとすると……
ん？

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
On closer inspection, your face...
I feel I have seen it somewhere before...
Alas, it's no use. I cannot remember.
text_block_list.orig_text:
よく見ると、
お主の顔、
どこかで見たことがあるような……
ダメじゃ、
思い出せぬ。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
At any rate, it seems to me that you most likely hold the key
to recovering my true self.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ともかく、
お主がわらわの姿を
元に戻すための鍵である可能性は高そうじゃ。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Which would mean... if I consume your blood,
perhaps I will be restored for good...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうなると……
お主の血を飲めば、
元の姿に戻れるかもしれぬの……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: {0}! Offer up your lifeblood to your mistress!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}、お主の血を
わらわに飲ませるのじゃ！！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
That day, Illya chased {0} around
until they were both exhausted.
text_block_list.orig_text:
このあと、{0}はイリヤに
延々と追いかけられるのだった……
